tagline: Multi-utility industrial grain and livestock feed
hubs: Karnataka, Madhya Pradesh, Bihar, Maharashtra, Rajasthan, Andhra Pradesh
descriptionEn: Third most important cereal in India. Fast growing crop with high yield potential and starch value.
imageAlt: Fresh healthy corn cobs ripening on tall green maize stalks
harvestingIndicator: Cob husk leaves turn dry papery brown and black layer forms at seed base.
introTipEn: Side-dress Urea at knee-high stage and maintain adequate moisture during tasseling and silking to maximize cob length and kernel fill.
efficiencyGain: 22% higher grain weight with split nitrogen doses
micronutrientNote: Zinc deficiency causes white stripes on young upper leaves. Apply ZnSO4 10 kg/acre basal.
stagnationAlert: Maize is very sensitive to waterlogging. Drain excess water within 12 hours to prevent root death.

fertilizerStages.quantityPerAcre: 40 kg DAP + 20 kg MOP + 10 kg ZnSO4

fertilizerStages.applicationMethod: Side-dress along plant row followed by earthing up

irrigation.criticalStagesEn: Knee-High Stage (25–35 DAS), Tasseling & Silking (50–65 DAS), Grain Dough Stage (75–85 DAS)
irrigation.tipsEn: Maize is very sensitive to waterlogging. Drain excess water within 12 hours to prevent root death.

pestsDiseases.symptomsEn: Shot-holes and ragged window-paning on leaves with heavy frass in central whorls.
pestsDiseases.controlEn: Spray Spinetoram 11.7% SC (0.5 ml/L) or Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC (0.4 ml/L) directly into whorls.

pestsDiseases.symptomsEn: Dead heart in young plants and pinholes on leaves.
pestsDiseases.controlEn: Whorl application of Carbofuran 3G or Cartap 4G at 3 kg/acre.

pestsDiseases.symptomsEn: Long boat-shaped grayish-brown lesions on lower leaves progressing upwards.
pestsDiseases.controlEn: Foliar spray with Mancozeb 75% WP (2.5 g/L water).

harvestSteps.textEn: Check for brown dry husk leaves and dark black layer at kernel base.
De-husk cobs and spread on dry concrete yard under sun for 4–5 days.
Shell kernels using power threshers when kernel moisture reaches 14%.
Store clean dry grain in aerated bags. Expected yield: 20–28 Qtl/acre.
